about_the_game:
SURVIVE, EXPLORE, REPEAT

Survive against waves of enemies in quick, intense rounds as you explore the randomly generated dungeons. Your cursor becomes the hero, battling against foes in a bullet hell frenzy that tests your reflexes, precision, and decision-making.

PLAY ON YOUR DESKTOP

Desktop Survivors 98 doesn’t play in a window — it plays over your desktop. Enemies, upgrades, and chaos unfold across your real screen.

Whether you’re looking for a quick break or an extended challenge, Desktop Survivors 98 fits perfectly into your routine. With its fast-paced rounds and the ability to toggle the game at any moment, you’re always just a click away from diving back into the action.

Key Features

  • Play Directly on Your Desktop: The action unfolds right on your desktop, overlaying seamlessly over anything you’re doing—perfect for multitasking!

  • Cursor Combat: Your cursor becomes the hero, engaging in progressively fast-paced battles against waves of enemies.

  • Dangerous Enemy Waves: Survive relentless hordes in a bullet hell experience that challenges your skills and reaction time.

  • Variety of Weapons and Upgrades: Discover, acquire, and upgrade powerful items as you progress.

  • Nostalgic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in retro-inspired visuals that capture the charm of classic PC gaming.

  • Take a Break Anytime: Toggle the game on or off at any moment to pause, step away, and return whenever you’re ready.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent) or better
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
